title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive | Bokun

About Tripadvisor 

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

About Bokun:

Bókun, a Tripadvisor company, is the market-leading booking and channel management platform for the tours and activities industry. Thousands of Experience Operators around the world run their business on Bókun - from independent tour guides to multi-location attraction groups. We combine the reach and stability of a global leader with the speed and focus of a team that’s still building.

About The Role:

We’re creating a new Business Development Executive role to close the gap between how Experience Operators discover Bókun and how they grow with us. Today, customers either self-serve their way in or land with a dedicated Business Development Manager once they’re a Key Account. This role owns everything in between.

You’ll own, grow and retain a portfolio of accounts with real potential - nurturing them over time and helping them get more value from Bókun. Some will grow into Key Accounts. Others will make this tier their long-term home, and need consistent account management and retention through our touchpoint programme - both are equally part of the job. You’ll also go after new business beyond our self-serve ICP: the accounts that need a conversation, not just a sign-up form. And you’ll work alongside our Business Development Managers to help qualify new potential enterprise opportunities.

It’s a role built for someone who’s equally comfortable prospecting cold leads and nurturing warm opportunities - patient enough to play the long game with an account, and driven enough to go and win the next one. Wherever each account is headed, they deserve someone who takes real ownership of getting them there.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week/month in our London office.

What You'll Do:

•
Own, grow and retain a portfolio of accounts - driving growth toward Key Account status where the opportunity exists, and providing consistent account management and retention through our touchpoint programme for those that stay in this tier.

•
Win new business beyond our self-serve ICP - proactively identify, prospect and convert Experience Operators whose needs go beyond a self-serve sign-up.

•
Represent Bókun at industry events and trade shows, building pipeline and relationships through in-person prospecting.

•
Work alongside Business Development Managers to help qualify new potential enterprise opportunities - bringing research, discovery and relationship-building to deals as they take shape.

•
Run consultative discovery calls, demos and webinars that show Experience Operators the value of the Bókun platform.

•
Use Salesforce and sales data to track your pipeline, spot trends, and sharpen your approach to outreach, account growth and retention.

•
Consistently meet and exceed targets across new business acquisition, account growth and retention.

•  

What You'll Bring to the Team:

•
3+ years of experience in sales, business development or account management, ideally in SaaS or B2B.

•
A track record that spans both sides of the job: winning new business and growing existing accounts.

•
Comfort working in a role that’s still being defined - you’ll help build the playbook, not just follow one.

•
Confident, consultative communication skills - on the phone, on a webinar, or on a trade show floor.

•

title: Pricing Operations Lead
description:
About the Team

The Pricing & Monetization team is responsible for how our products create and capture value. We partner closely with Product, GTM, Finance, and Systems teams to design pricing models, packaging, and commercial strategies that support adoption, growth, and long-term scaling of the business.

To thrive in this team, you need to be a proactive problem-solver who excels at bringing structure to ambiguous challenges. Our work demands strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and precision in execution. Team members succeed when they are analytical, detail-oriented, skilled at balancing multiple priorities, and passionate about driving high-stakes projects forward to deliver meaningful results.

About the Role

We are looking for a Pricing Operations Lead to help translate pricing and packaging decisions into clear, scalable execution. You will work closely with pricing leaders and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Billing, Finance, and GTM to ensure pricing changes are implemented accurately, system requirements are well managed, and launch decisions move from strategy to reality with discipline.

You should be comfortable operating at the intersection of business judgment, systems thinking, and program management. This role will help shape the operating backbone for pricing implementation, support teams developing billing and related monetization systems, and ensure the pricing team's needs are represented clearly in cross-functional planning and execution.

In this role, you will:

- Lead the operational execution of pricing and packaging decisions from approval through implementation and launch

- Translate pricing strategy, policies, and launch decisions into clear business requirements for billing, quoting, revenue, and related systems teams

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Billing, Finance, and GTM teams to manage dependencies, scope tradeoffs, testing needs, and launch readiness

- Own pricing-related requirement intake and prioritization on behalf of the pricing team, ensuring requests are clear, well managed, and tied to business needs

- Support the design and implementation of new product, SKU, packaging, and billing configurations as pricing changes move into production

- Establish lightweight but effective pricing operations processes, including governance, documentation, sign-offs, and issue tracking

- Identify recurring friction in pricing execution and drive improvements that reduce ambiguity, delays, and rework

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 6+ years of experience leading pricing operations or closely related monetization, commercialization, or revenue operations work

- Have a strong track record of helping implement complex pricing or packaging decisions across cross-functional teams

- Can translate pricing intent into practical system requirements, launch plans, operating workflows, and stakeholder decisions

- Have experience partnering closely with billing systems, product, engineering, finance, and go-to-market teams

- Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, risks, and timelines at once

- Communicate clearly with both business and technical audiences, and can drive accountability without creating unnecessary process

- Care deeply about operational precision, customer clarity, and building systems that scale as pricing complexity grows

- Are a self-starter who can roll up your sleeves and operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment

title: Staff Security Software Engineer, IAM
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Security Engineering team, you will be a founding member of the team and define and drive the technical strategy for identity and access at Harvey - both how customers authenticate to Harvey, as well as how internal employees, contractors, and non-human identities access company systems, what they are authorized to do, and how seamlessly access adapts as needs change.

Challenges ahead include exploring how AI-powered access management can understand employee needs, recommend appropriate permissions, streamline decisions, and adapt access as roles and responsibilities evolve, as well as shaping an end user/agent authentication experience that makes signing in to Harvey fast, consistent, reliable, and secure across every surface where our customers work.

You will operate at the boundary of security, infrastructure, and product engineering - turning ambitious business and technical requirements into durable identity platforms, clear architectural direction, and exceptional user experiences. This role is hands-on, but its primary leverage comes through technical direction, platform adoption, cross-functional alignment, and enabling other engineers to build on strong identity foundations.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Define Harvey's multi-year technical strategy for identity, authentication, authorization, and privileged access.

- Design and build complex identity systems from greenfield - writing the code, instrumenting it, and owning it in production.

- Lead the architecture and execution of cross-functional initiatives to right-size access at scale, spanning identity and authentication, permissions and authorization, entitlement modeling, and access controls.

- Extend the identity model to non-human and agentic identities, so that AI agents acting on behalf of users are authenticated, scoped, and auditable.

- Serve as the technical authority for identity and access architecture and guide major design reviews, investment decisions, and long-term roadmaps.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- 10+ years experience building and operating production software, with demonstrated impact across multiple teams or technical domains.

- Deep expertise in several identity and access engineering domains - authentication, federation, authorization, entitlement modeling, or privileged access.

- Fluency with AI: you use AI-assisted development tools effectively while applying strong engineering judgment, and you design agentic workflows that automate repetitive toil and improve how teams operate.

- Experience designing identity or authorization platforms, libraries, or abstractions used by other engineering teams.

- Experience delivering foundational systems that achieve meaningful adoption and improve organizational or custom

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

​
A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA
“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

title: Game Economy Designer [RnD]
description:

Ми шукаємо системного економіста, який візьме на себе управління балансом нашої F2P-гри. Ваше головне завдання - зробити так, щоб гра була захопливою для гравців і водночас прибутковою для бізнесу. Ви не просто працюватимете з цифрами в таблицях, а проєктуватимете системну архітектуру економіки: створюватимете дефіцит ресурсів, готуватимете технічні завдання для програмістів і будуватимете надійну логіку економіки, усуваючи потенційні вразливості ще до релізу.
Основні обовʼязки:

• Баланс економіки: Налаштування отримання та витрат усіх видів ресурсів. Контроль цінності ігрових валют від Tutorial до Late Game.

• Дизайн прогресії: розрахунок досвіду, налаштування темпу гри та тривалості ігрових сесій. Контроль лімітів і створення мотивації регулярно повертатися до гри.

• Монетизація: Налаштування єдиної економіки. Балансування цін для гібридної моделі IAP + Ads.

• Технічний геймдизайн: написання Production-ready GDD для розробників із зазначенням лімітів, форматів даних та вимог до аналітики.

• Аудит: ведення єдиної бази знань з економіки проєкту.

• Пошук і усунення вразливостей у логіці та балансі гри.

• Побудова та підтримка живих економічних моделей: формули прогресії, криві складності, симуляції.

• Баланс ШІ.

• Аналіз даних плейтестів і поведінкових метрик, пошук дисбалансу; обґрунтування кожного рішення числами.

• Написання production-ready документації для розробників (ліміти, формати даних, вимоги до аналітики).

• Кооперація з геймдизайном, розробкою та аналітикою; реалізація в межах віжену геймдизайнера; пропозиції щодо покращень.

Вимоги:

• Досвідвід 3 років роботи економістом у мобільних F2P-іграх, досвід налаштування Core- та Meta-циклів.

• Обов'язковий досвід роботи з іграми на етапі оперування (LiveOps).

• Поглиблене володіння Excel або Google Sheets (складні формули, зведені таблиці, масиви, індекси).

• Вміння будувати математичні моделі, які легко читати, підтримувати та змінювати.

• Розуміння теорії ймовірностей (Gacha, шанси випадіння предметів), комбінаторики та принципів розрахунку кривих прогресії.

• Розуміння метрик утримання (Retention, Session Length) і монетизації (LTV, ARPDAU, Conversion Rate), а також того, як баланс впливає на поведінку гравця.

• Знання SQL для самостійного отримання та аналізу даних.

Додаткові вимоги:

• AI-Native Workflow: AI для вас - не просто чати та промпти, а інструмент, що багаторазово прискорює роботу. Ви готові до стандартів індустрії, вільно використовуєте нейромережі для симуляції тисяч ігрових сесій, генерації Python-коду для розрахунків балансу та як повноцінного ко-пілота під час написання ТЗ.

• Просунуті навичкиPython (Pandas/NumPy) для складних розрахунків. Досвід візуального моделювання систем. Просунуте володіння SQL для складної аналітики.

• Навичка прорахувати, чи матиме гравець надлишок або нестачу ігрової валюти через пів року гри (LTV 180+), ще на етапі задуму нової фічі.

Передбачувані етапи інтервʼю:

• Інтервʼю з рекрутером

• Тестове завдання (опціонально)

• Інтервʼю з наймаючим менеджером

• Збір рекомендацій

• Офер

Ми пропонуємо:
Бенефіт-кафе: Свобода вибору - персональний бюджет на страхування, навчання, спортзал чи будь-що для твого балансу.
Бонуси за досягнення: Цінуємо strive for excellence і командну гру, відзначаємо помітні результати, ініціативу та реальний вплив.
Remote First: Працюй з будь-якої точки світу віддалена робота є стандартом, а не винятком.
Вплив на бізнес: Мінімум бюрократії, максимум свободи дій і можливість втілювати свої ідеї.
Career Boost: Розвиток професійної експертизи, навчання, внутрішні тренінги, стратегічні сесії.
Culture Driver: Атмосфера єдиної команди, де успіх - результат спільної праці.

title: AI Video Annotator
description:
About the Role
We are looking for detail-oriented annotators to help label robot manipulation videos for AI training purposes. You'll watch short videos of robots performing manipulation tasks (filmed from three synchronized camera angles) and produce precise, structured, natural-language descriptions of the actions taking place. This work directly supports the development of robotics AI models and requires strong written English, sharp observational skills, and the discipline to follow a detailed style guide consistently.
Project Details

•
Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotator

•
Location: Remote in India/Philippines﻿/Egypt/Mexico

•
Work type: Freelance

•
Language: English

•
Pay Rate: US$3.5 per hour

What You'll Do

• Watch short robot manipulation videos, each filmed from three synchronized camera views (an overhead view and views from each of the robot's two wrist-mounted cameras).

• Break each video into time segments and write clear, natural-language descriptions for each segment.

• Apply labels at three levels of detail for each applicable segment:

•
Atomic motion (a few seconds) - a single small movement (e.g., "close fingers around the red handle")

•
Skill / subtask (several seconds to ~20 seconds) - a complete, meaningful action (e.g., "pick up the red block by its edge")

•
Task / goal (up to ~1 minute) - the overall purpose of a sequence of skills (e.g., "place all blocks in the container")

• Ensure every moment of video is covered by a label at two or more of these levels - no gaps, including idle or pause moments.

• Accurately describe exactly what happens, including when something doesn't go as planned (a dropped object, a failed grasp, a slipped grip). Precision matters more than making the robot look successful.

• Cross-reference all three camera angles: use the overhead view to understand the overall scene and object identity, and the close-up wrist views to confirm exact contact and grasp details.

• Follow a detailed style guide covering vocabulary for actions, spatial relationships, object descriptions, and manner of movement, applying it consistently across many episodes.

• Participate in periodic calibration sessions to align your labeling with the team and the client's reference examples.
What We're Looking For
Required:

• Strong written English - you'll write dozens of short, precise descriptive sentences per video and need to vary your language rather than repeating the same phrases.

• Sharp attention to detail - able to distinguish small differences (a successful grasp vs. a fumble, a push vs. a drag, which specific object part is being touched).

• Comfort following a detailed, structured style guide and applying it consistently, even in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios.

• Basic comfort with spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, naming object parts like handles, lids, or edges).

• Reliable, self-directed work habits - this is often heads-down work with periodic check-ins rather than close supervision.
Nice to Have:

• Prior experience with video annotation, data labeling, transcription, or QA work.

• Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation) - helpful but not necessary, as the style guide is self-contained.

• Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio.

title: Senior Illustrator
description:
About Us:
Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts , processing billions of Naira’s in transactions monthly . Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.
About this role:
We are looking for a talented Illustrator to create original pieces of artwork for Moniepoint products. You will work as part of our User Experience, digital & creative team, interpreting complex briefs and developing inspiring artwork that will attract our target audience. You will be responsible for formulating concepts and rendering draft illustrations from written words, models, sketched ideas, and from your imagination. Ultimately, we are hiring a creative individual who can turn concepts into artistic marketable images.
Responsibilities:

• Prepare rough draft illustrations according to requirements and the company’s specifications and needs.

• Create complete illustrations and refine design concepts using a wide range of colors, graphics, effects, and illustration software.

• Apply isometric techniques to add perspective to complex visual shapes.

• Ensure that all digital illustrations meet high quality and color standards.

• Brainstorm with the design team to come up with new creative ideas, patterns, visual styles, and concepts.

• Stay up-to-date with emerging design techniques, industry trends, and graphics software.

Experience & Background:

• Bachelor's degree in fine arts, design, visual arts, or a related field.

• At least 4-5 years of proven work experience as an Illustrator, Graphic Designer, or similar visual design role.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating a diverse range of completed illustrations.

• Proven hands-on work experience using computer-aided design (CAD) software.

Skills & Competencies:

• Advanced drawing, painting, and digital artwork rendering skills.

• Deep expertise in image editing and design tools such as Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.

• Strong conceptual thinking and artistic problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to manage time effectively, work under pressure, and meet strict deadlines.

What Success Looks Like in This Role:

• Consistently transforming abstract product ideas into engaging, marketable visual assets across touchpoints.

• High brand aesthetic consistency and technical alignment across all digital art and user experiences.

• Active creative collaboration with design teams to continually elevate Moniepoint 's visual language and illustration standards.

• Reliable and on-time delivery of high-quality illustrations that satisfy complex cross-functional briefs.

Why Join Us?

•
Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.

•
Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.

•
Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

Mercer Advisors is a people business, and our advisors are the people. When an advisor has a great day, clients feel it. When an advisor spends that day on 20 clicks per task, status calls, and workarounds, clients feel that too. We're rebuilding how our Platform organization works - and we need someone who owns the advisor experience end to end.

title: Technical project manager - Network infrastructure - APAC
description:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role
We're looking for a Lead Technical Project Manager for Network Infrastructure. This is not a "make slides, chase tickets, and ask engineers for status" job. It is a role for someone with an engineering skeleton: a person who has built, operated, broken and recovered things, and can earn trust in a room full of SREs, SWEs, network engineers, security and platform teams. We are at the early stage of our APAC expansion, so you will work with a high degree of independence, set up the project management practices for the region from scratch, and stay close to the technical details yourself.
The "T" matters. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every area, but you should be technical enough to understand real trade-offs: why rollback is not optional, why "just automate it" can create a bigger blast radius, why a provisioning flow must survive real-world constraints, why SLOs without ownership are decoration, and why network device CI/CD is very different from deploying a stateless service. You can read a design doc, challenge missing assumptions, notice unclear failure modes, ask sharp questions, and turn a vague but important problem into an executable plan.
The "P" is project delivery with a product mindset, even if the product is internal infrastructure. Your product may be a site bootstrap kit, secrets and robot-user management, an SLO framework, a firmware rollout process, a network observability platform, CI/CD for network devices, or automation that makes day-0 and day-N operations safe. The job is not done when the technical pieces exist. It is done when engineers trust the tool, the NOC actually uses the workflow, alerts are actionable, runbooks are real, and the new way becomes the default way. That means adoption, communication, documentation, feedback loops, and sometimes a bit of internal "marketing": the ability to convince smart technical people that the thing is worth using.
The "M" is management of execution, not people management. You will not be responsible for engineers' careers, performance reviews or promotions. You will be responsible for making important cross-team initiatives land: defining scope, aligning owners, exposing risks, driving decisions, tracking dependencies, creating clarity where things are unclear, and making sure we ship useful outcomes instead of collecting half-finished initiatives.

title: Oracle EPM Developer
description:
Our Technology Practice partners with organizations to design, build, and scale innovative digital solutions that drive measurable business impact. We bring together product strategists, engineers, architects, data experts, and transformation leaders to solve complex challenges across cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, enterprise platforms, and modern application development. We don’t just implement technology, we translate business strategy into scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions. Our teams work at the intersection of innovation and execution, helping clients modernize legacy systems, accelerate digital transformation, and unlock the full value of emerging technologies. We foster a collaborative, growth-oriented environment where technologists are empowered to solve meaningful problems, continuously learn, and deliver high-impact outcomes.
What We're Looking For
Michael Baker International is seeking an Oracle EPM Developer to join our Technology Practice within the Business Applications team in a remote role based in the United States. In this role, you will help manage, maintain, enhance, and expand our Oracle Enterprise Performance Management Cloud ecosystem, supporting current applications while helping implement new EPM capabilities as business needs evolve. • Help expand the EPM environment through future application development, new capability implementation, proof-of-concept support, and discovery efforts for additional EPM modules.

• Write, test, troubleshoot, and maintain business rules, calculation scripts, planning logic, and related EPM development components.

• Support the broader EPM suite by applying transferable knowledge across Oracle EPM applications as new modules are evaluated, implemented, or expanded.

• Maintain and troubleshoot EPM data integration processes, including data loads, mappings, validations, reconciliations, and issue resolution.

• Support recurring planning, forecasting, reporting, reconciliation, and close-related cycles by ensuring EPM applications, data, and calculations perform as expected.

• Review Oracle EPM updates and assess potential impacts to applications, integrations, reports, forms, business rules, security, and user processes.

• Create and maintain documentation for configurations, integrations, support procedures, development standards, and end-user processes.

title: Sales VA
description:
About High Scale
We’re High Scale - a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition-that’s the DNA behind everything we do.
Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026-and we need a Sales VA who is hungry, organized, and ready to fuel our growth engine by filling the pipeline with high-quality leads.
Why This Role Matters
Pipeline, precision, and momentum are your playground. As a Sales VA, you are the first line of offense for our growth team. You aren't just an "assistant"; you are a lead generation machine. You enable our Account Executives to focus on one thing: closing deals.
By taking ownership of prospecting, CRM management, and initial outreach, you directly impact the agency's revenue. If you enjoy the thrill of the hunt, love organized data, and want to learn the inner workings of a high-performance sales organization, this is your launchpad.
What You’ll Do

•
Lead Generation & Prospecting

• Research and build targeted lists of potential clients (DTC brands in fashion, beauty, and tech) using tools like Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Crunchbase.

• Verify contact information (emails, phone numbers) to ensure low bounce rates and high deliverability.

• Qualify leads based on specific criteria (revenue size, ad spend, industry) before adding them to the pipeline.

•
CRM Management

• Maintain impeccable data hygiene in our CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce). Ensure every lead, contact, and deal is updated with the correct status and notes.

• Move prospects through the sales funnel stages based on triggers and interactions.

•
Outreach & Appointment Setting

• Assist with high-volume cold email and LinkedIn DM campaigns. Personalize templates to increase response rates.

• Handle initial responses and scheduling, booking discovery calls directly onto the Sales Directors' calendars.

• Conduct follow-ups with warm leads to ensure no opportunity falls through the cracks.

•
Sales Admin Support

• Prepare meeting briefs, research notes, and slide decks for upcoming sales calls.

• Draft contracts and agreements using templates for review by the closing team.

Who You Are

•
A Lead Gen Specialist

• 1-3 years of experience in sales support, lead generation, or business development (BDR/SDR support).

• Familiarity with prospecting tools (, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) is highly preferred.

•
CRM Savvy

• You know your way around a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive). You understand the importance of logging activity.

•
Excellent Writer

• Strong English proficiency (C1/C2) is required. You will be writing emails and messages on behalf of the agency. Your grammar and tone must be flawless.

•
Organized & Relentless

• You can handle repetitive tasks (data entry, scraping) without losing focus or accuracy.

• You have a "hunter" mindset-you enjoy finding the right contact at a hard-to-reach company.

•
Tech-Fluent

• Comfortable using Google Workspace, Slack, and email automation tools (Instantly, Lemlist, etc.).

Perks & Benefits

• Growth Opportunities: Master the sales process and grow into a Junior Sales Rep or Business Development Representative (BDR).

• Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world-one qualified lead at a time.

description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités
Dans le cadre de la dématérialisation de procédures métiers liées au classement, à la restauration et aux subventions de biens patrimoniaux, un programme de transformation prévoit la mise en place d’une plateforme intégrée de gestion interne, de référentiels et de publication de données.
Cette plateforme doit couvrir l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’un dossier et s’interfacer avec plusieurs applications régionales et fédérales afin d’assurer un parcours utilisateur complet. Elle est développée sur Odoo et interagira avec d’autres modules, notamment un site web, des composants géomatiques et une plateforme d’échange.
La mission consiste à soutenir la coordination des tests métier et fonctionnels avec une approche de testing applicatif end-to-end sur la plateforme et ses intégrations. L’objectif est de garantir la qualité et l’exhaustivité des scénarios de test, d’exécuter les tests en amont des utilisateurs métier et de faire remonter les résultats en vue des corrections et améliorations.
Vous intervenez dès le démarrage du projet et collaborez avec les chefs de projet, la coordination du programme, les responsables qualité et tests, ainsi qu’avec les équipes métier impliquées.
Vos principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :

• mettre en place un cadre de testing métier avec les testeurs concernés, incluant la méthode, la gouvernance, les livrables et l’organisation des tests ;

• assister la coordination des tests dans la définition, la structuration et la rédaction des scénarios de tests fonctionnels ;

• élaborer les plans de test de conformité et de non-régression pour l’ensemble de la plateforme et de ses interfaces ;

• rédiger et maintenir les scénarios de test dans Xray sous Jira ;

• exécuter les tests applicatifs et assurer le suivi des plans de test, des résultats et des rapports ;

• identifier les anomalies et non-conformités, puis les communiquer à l’équipe en charge de leur traitement ;

• participer à la communauté de pratique des testeurs ;

• intervenir, selon les besoins, sur des tests d’intégration et de performance ;

• utiliser des outils de test dédiés, par exemple SOAPUI, et contribuer à des actions d’automatisation, notamment avec Playwright.

📝 Votre profil
Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant que testeur applicatif.

• Très bonne compréhension technique et fonctionnelle d’une application et de ses intégrations.

• Capacité à restituer des aspects techniques par écrit de manière simple et compréhensible.

• Expérience dans l’exécution de tests informatiques, y compris la rédaction de plans de test, l’exécution, le suivi, le reporting et la gestion des anomalies.

• Maîtrise de la gestion de tests de conformité, d’intégration, de non-régression et de performance.

• Bonne connaissance de Jira et Xray.

• Pratique d’un environnement de test dédié, par exemple SOAPUI, avec compréhension de sa technicité.

• Connaissance de Scrum et du travail en contexte agile.

• Des connaissances en automatisation de tests, par exemple avec Playwright, constituent un atout.

• Très bonnes capacités rédactionnelles.

• Vous travaillez avec autonomie, rigueur, structure et sens du formalisme.

• Vous faites preuve de proactivité, d’esprit d’équipe et d’une démarche d’amélioration continue.

• Vous savez collaborer avec des interlocuteurs métier exigeants, avec diplomatie.

• Le français est requis.

SumUp  enables businesses to get paid easily, process orders quickly, sell online instantly and manage their money more efficiently. We create the tools businesses need to make their business and their customer experience thrive. 

The  payments processing platform,  consisting of other sub-platforms, has powered SumUp’s global business for more than 10 years now. It’s developed in Sofia by the Payments Tribe, composed of several teams (squads). Each squad is cross-functional, autonomous and co-located, working on its part of the platform  end-to-end.  

Now, we are taking a major step forward in our Payments journey: building our own acquiring capability in Europe.

About the team

You’ll join a growing Payments team working on the next generation of SumUp’s payment capabilities. The team is building and evolving foundational systems that will improve the reliability, scalability and flexibility of our products.

This is an opportunity to work on a new and important area of our platform, where your technical decisions will help shape how SumUp supports millions of small businesses around the world. You’ll have the chance to contribute from an early stage, solve complex engineering challenges and see the impact of your work in real-world payment experiences.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer in our own acquiring team, you’ll help build and evolve the systems that power SumUp’s payment experiences. You’ll work on foundational, greenfield components that improve the reliability and scalability of our platform while enabling us to deliver new payment capabilities to small businesses around the world. This is an opportunity to influence architectural decisions, shape engineering practices and work on highly critical infrastructure from the ground up.

What you’ll do:

•
Design and build core acquiring capabilities, including authorisation, clearing and settlement processing.

•
Develop the APIs, data models and services that will form the foundation of our acquiring platform.

•
Build reporting, back-office and operational tools for a reliable day-to-day acquiring operation.

•
Ensure our systems meet card-scheme, security and compliance requirements.

•
Create strong observability, monitoring and incident-response foundations for an always-on payments platform.

•
Work closely with teams across Processing, Reconciliation, Risk, Compliance, Finance and Treasury.

•
Contribute to architecture discussions and make sound technical decisions in an ambiguous, evolving domain.

•
Take ownership of medium-to-large technical initiatives that span multiple teams.

•
Identify and help prioritise technical debt, operational risks and opportunities to improve the platform.

•
Support the growth of the team through mentoring, code reviews and shaping testing and on-call practices.

•
Understanding of software architecture, design principles, data modelling, API design and SOLID principles.

•
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with PostgreSQL and Kafka is valuable.

•
Practical experience with Docker, AWS and Kubernetes.

•
A DevOps mindset and an interest in building, operating and improving the systems you own.

•
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate complex issues methodically.

•
A collaborative approach and openness to feedback.

•
A strong sense of ownership and accountability for your work.

It would be a great advantage if you have:

•
Experience with Elixir or another functional programming language.

•
Experience with AWS Prometheus and Grafana.

•
Experience in fintech, payments or another regulated domain.

•
Knowledge of card schemes, acquiring, authorisation, clearing or settlement.
